Responsibilities<\/strong>

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome\u2019s core business operations for our next phase of growth.<\/span>

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.<\/span>

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform\u2019s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.<\/span>

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.<\/span>

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.<\/span><\/li>
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.<\/span><\/li>
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.<\/span><\/li>
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.<\/span><\/li>
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.<\/span><\/li>
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.<\/span><\/li>
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.<\/span><\/li><\/ul><\/p>
    Skills<\/strong>

    • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).<\/span><\/li>
    • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.<\/span><\/li>
    • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.<\/span><\/li>
    • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.<\/span><\/li>
    • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.<\/span><\/li>
    • Business fluency in both\u00a0<\/span>English and German<\/span>\u00a0is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.\u00a0<\/span><\/li><\/ul><\/p>
      What we offer<\/strong>

      Hybrid Work \/\/ Stay flexible:\u00a0<\/span>We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.<\/span>

      Room to grow \/\/ Stay curious:<\/span>\u00a0In regular\/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.<\/span>

      Mental & physical health \/\/ Stay healthy & active:<\/span>\u00a0We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner \"F\u00fcrstenberg Institute\" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.<\/span>

      Taking responsibility \/\/ We #care:<\/span>\u00a0We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.<\/span>

      Teamspirit \/\/ Stay connected:\u00a0<\/span>What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.<\/span>

      W\u00e4hrend des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein pers\u00f6nliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B.       Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und F\u00e4higkeiten an.

      Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abl\u00e4ufe im Unternehmen.<\/span><\/p>

      #Einkauf<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Du unterst\u00fctzt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivit\u00e4ten.\u00a0
      <\/span>#Marktanalyse<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>

      #Perspektiven<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>
      <\/span>Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche T\u00e4tigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsm\u00f6glichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
      <\/span>#Team:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per \u201aDu\u2018. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.<\/span>
      <\/span>#Weiterbildung<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.<\/span>
      <\/span>#Steile Lernkurve<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0\u00a0<\/span>

      <\/span>Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem B\u00fcro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der B\u00fcroarbeitstage variieren.\u00a0<\/span><\/p>
      Was solltest du mitbringen?<\/strong>

      #Background<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufm\u00e4nnische Ausbildung absolviert und m\u00f6chtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln k\u00f6nnen?
      <\/span>#Leidenschaft<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Technik l\u00e4sst dein Herz h\u00f6herschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich n\u00e4mlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.\u00a0\u00a0
      <\/span>#Verhandlungsgeschick<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Du bist aufgeschlossen und \u00fcberzeugst deine Gespr\u00e4chspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen F\u00e4higkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gesp\u00fcr f\u00fcr gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.<\/span>
      #Pers\u00f6nlichkeit<\/strong>:<\/span><\/strong>
      <\/span>Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilit\u00e4t und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstst\u00e4ndig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
      <\/span>#Was noch?<\/strong><\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span>
      <\/span>Excel oder sogar Pivot sind f\u00fcr dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse k\u00f6nntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern \u00fcberzeugen.
      <\/span>
      <\/span>Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - \u00fcberzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der\/die Richtige bist ;)<\/strong><\/span><\/strong><\/span>\u00a0<\/span><\/p>

      \"Teamarbeit steht im Vordergrund, man sollte sich immer auf das Team verlassen k\u00f6nnen.\"<\/p>

      \u2013 Christian<\/p>

      \"Mir ist es wichtig, dass man sich mit dem Job und NBB identifiziert und wir alle an einem Strang ziehen.\"<\/p>

      \u2013 Manuela<\/p><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Help Us Change the Way the World Works<\/h1>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Build something that matters.<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          About Langdock<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology and adoption. We build a secure, model-agnostic AI platform that helps companies put AI to work across their entire organization. From chat and agents to integrations, workflows, and our API, we give teams the tools to augment and automate their work.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          We apply the same ambition internally. We want to be the most productive company in the world, and that means continuously improving how we work, not simply adding more people to existing processes.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          About the Role<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Help Langdock understand what drives growth, and engineer the data foundations and systems that make those answers reliable.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          We are hiring our first dedicated RevOps Engineer (Data & BI) to give Revenue Operations the capacity to own both commercial data architecture and the processes connecting our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          At Langdock, commercial teams are technical and dedicate ~30% of their time to building. This means frontline workflows are designed and maintained close to the people using them. RevOps shifts focus toward more complex cross-functional challenges: architecting our commercial data model, delivering robust BI, and engineering seamless inter-team processes.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Your ownership of the core data domain will create the room to scale growth projects, account handovers, CRM standards, and renewal\/expansion architectures.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The role combines two core focus areas:<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ~70% Applied Data & BI:<\/strong> Connect commercial, product, and billing data, build reliable models and reporting, and investigate questions that shape commercial decisions. You will own initiatives from initial business questions through modeling, validation, and analysis, helping teams act on the results.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ~30% Cross-Functional RevOps Systems & Processes:<\/strong> Help design and improve how teams collaborate - from lead lifecycle stages and Sales-to-CS handovers to renewal, expansion, and billing processes. Working alongside the functional teams, you will clarify responsibilities, define required data touchpoints, and turn agreements into working, automated systems.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Langdock moves fast. This split provides a starting baseline, while priorities will evolve as our product portfolio and commercial organization scale. You will also take on high-impact special projects around growth initiatives and commercial operations.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What you will do<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Architect shared commercial data & BI:<\/strong> Connect customer, product, and revenue data across systems (CRM, billing, product databases, and GTM tools); maintain consistent core metrics; and provide reliable, actionable reporting.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Build in-house revenue & billing logic:<\/strong> Own and refine our revenue tracking, billing data reconciliation, and lifecycle metrics so leadership and commercial teams can rely on one source of truth.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Support commercial planning and measurement:<\/strong> Provide clean definitions and data models to inform company goals, quotas, commission\/compensation structures, forecasting, and account development.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Investigate growth drivers:<\/strong> Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, and Engineering to explore key commercial questions, uncover pipeline\/expansion bottlenecks, and validate hypotheses.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Optimize GTM funnels & lifecycle workflows:<\/strong> Define clear cross-team handoffs (e.g., Lead-to-Opportunity, Sales-to-CS, renewals, and expansions), ensuring clean CRM hygiene and minimal friction.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Leverage AI and modern automation internally:<\/strong> Use Langdock agents, automation tools, and CRM integrations to eliminate repetitive manual operational tasks and feed internal learnings back into our product.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What we are looking for<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You write clean, performant SQL with confidence and have hands-on experience combining data from disparate, sometimes messy sources into resilient relational models.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You treat data with an engineering mindset: you don't just write ad-hoc queries, you build sustainable data workflows, test edge cases, validate outputs, and document your work so others can build on top of it.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You think commercially and are curious about what makes businesses grow. You understand B2B SaaS mechanics and distinguish vanity dashboards from data that drives commercial decisions.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You have practical experience with CRM systems (such as HubSpot), modern billing data, and automation tools.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You build with AI. You have hands-on experience using AI and automation tools to solve real problems and streamline operational work.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You can listen to ambiguous business questions from sales, CS, or leadership, translate them into clear technical requirements, and communicate analytical findings with clarity.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Our Values<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Calm urgency.<\/strong> We move fast without chaos. We stay calm, fix what matters, and avoid unnecessary noise. We focus on solutions rather than complaints and make sure sleep, health, and sports keep our decision-making sharp.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Ambitious execution.<\/strong> We love building fast and with ownership. We aim to be the most productive company in the world. Learning, shipping, and improving bring us joy. Everyone is expected to ask questions, take initiative, and deliver reliably.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Caring ownership.<\/strong> We care deeply: about each other, customers, and the world around us. We act with empathy, sincerity, and long-term thinking. And we have fun along the way while spending time in the office together.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The Environment<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                We work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Stra\u00dfe 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves\u2014gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. Health is not separate from work here; it is part of how we work well.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Compensation & Leveling<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When you apply<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When you apply, we would love to see an example of a data model, analysis, or workflow automation you've built. Tell us what problem it solved, how it works, and what you learned.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \u00a0<\/div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Next steps<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to meet you.<\/p>

NetImpact has an opportunity for a ServiceNow System Administrator to join our talented IT Services team. This is a 100% remote position. We are seeking candidates who can demonstrate their ability to perform with agility and act with an understanding of the importance of the customer’s mission--delivering value by managing dynamic environments, objectives, and priorities. They will work with key stakeholders to design and develop enterprise business solutions for the customer and serve as a technical resource leading the configuration, development, support, and maintenance of a large, custom ServiceNow application suite of capabilities. The candidate will effectively leverage the ServiceNow platform and their own expertise to implement enterprise business solutions for our customer. They will be a member of a cross-functional team responsible for enhancing the ServiceNow platform, implementing new products, and developing custom ServiceNow solutions. The successful candidate can effectively provide strategic and tactical support to clients, support multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities. This position requires a full-time commitment.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide user support
  • Provide support for ServiceNow by troubleshooting a variety of difficult software problems, implementing bug fixes, and performing root cause analysis
  • Collaborate with project team members to design and deliver creative, scalable, and maintainable solutions to complex problems.
  • Ensure ongoing operations function as expected
  • Design and develop solutions within the ServiceNow environment to include new or modifications to applications, forms, workflow, policies, actions, access control, interfaces, and any other configurations required to support client processes
  • Create and maintain API and data integration processes between ServiceNow and other systems.
  • Investigate application behavior
  • Generate operational reports and KPI analysis as needed
  • Prepare client facing and internal deliverables that are technology related
  • Maintain production system reliability utilizing change management process
  • Monitor health, usage and overall compliance of the application
  • Assist with version upgrades and install patches

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS or Business-related discipline
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as ServiceNow Administrator
  • Experience supporting and troubleshooting custom ServiceNow applications in a production environment, including incident resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Experience working with business rules, client scripts, UI policies, flows, workflows, and other application configurations.

  • Understanding of ServiceNow security, including roles, ACLs, and user access.
  • Experience with update sets, release deployments, testing, and post-deployment validation.

Preferred

Job Description

NetImpact Strategies builds software for Federal agencies, and we build it with AI. We are hiring engineers who own a solution end to end: sit with the customer, turn what they need into a specification, direct AI coding agents to build it, prove it works, get it into a Federal production environment, and hand it to sustainment. You will work in Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and our proprietary AI software generation platform every day.

The Technical Architect extracts meaning from what a customer is asking and converts it into the right technology. The role is senior enough to own the architecture, close enough to the customer to understand the intent behind a request, and accountable when the solution goes live. The Core functions of the role are Research, Design, Architect, Code with AI, Solution Validation, and discipline to be productive with Client intimacy.

What makes the role different

This is not a conventional architect who designs and hands off, a people manager, or a quota-carrying salesperson. AI generation changes how code is produced, but it does not transfer accountability: production code ships under this role’s ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Participate directly in requirements capture, translate customer needs into fit-for-purpose solutions, and define the technical scope and boundaries for fixed-price engagements.
  • Convert customer requirements into structured specifications, acceptance criteria, and architectural decisions that enable AI-assisted software development, while validating generated solutions before release.
  • Lead production integration, guide deployments, and remain accountable through deployment, stabilization, customer acceptance, and knowledge transfer to ensure successful delivery.
  • Ensure solutions are extensible, maintainable, and transferable so they can be supported and enhanced by other qualified team members.
  • Deliver production-ready solutions by supporting cloud deployments, CI/CD, legacy system integration, and compliance with ATO/RMF, Section 508, and NIST requirements.
  • Create reusable assets, share lessons learned across the organization, and identify opportunities for follow-on work while transitioning commercial activities to the appropriate stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Demonstrate a strong foundation in software engineering principles and manual coding, with the ability to architect and deliver solutions across modern programming languages, frameworks, cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools, and low-code platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.6+ years of professional software delivery, including enterprise systems you carried into production and supported after go-live.
  • A complete solution built primarily with agentic AI coding tools. At least one working, end-to-end application you built by directing Claude Code, Codex, Copilot agent mode, Cursor, or an equivalent tool. Work or substantive personal projects both count. You will be asked to show it and to build live during the interview.
  • Enterprise delivery experience. Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale software delivery, including production integration, deployment, operational constraints, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Architect-level depth. Strong systems-design judgment plus working fluency across analysis, product ownership, software development, project delivery, security, data, integrations, and operations.
  • AI-directed solution delivery. Evidence of independently building complete working solutions primarily through AI-assisted generation. Substantive personal projects may demonstrate this capability.

// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. The Role_

Working across the engineering organisation, you’ll act as a senior technical leader within the payments domain: contributing to architecture, guiding complex decisions and helping teams build scalable, resilient systems that support millions of journeys worldwide.

  • Support teams in building towards a modern, microservices-based architecture while balancing delivery priorities and long-term platform health

  • Stay close to technical delivery through architecture reviews, design discussions and targeted hands-on contribution where needed

  • Identify and work through complex technical challenges related to scalability, resilience, operational performance and system evolution

  • Act as a senior technical advisor across engineering teams, supporting and influencing technical decisions, particularly within the payments domain

  • Work with external providers and payment partners on integrations, technical alignment and problem-solving

  • Contribute to technical roadmap planning, prioritisation, technical scoping and architecture discussions for complex initiatives

  • Produce clear technical documentation and contribute to engineering standards, technical forums and good practices across the organisation

// You bring a mix of strong technical expertise, sound judgement and real-world payments experience.

  • Strong experience working on payment systems, including integrations with PSPs, gateways, EMV, contactless EMV, acquirers, etc.

  • Good understanding of payment flows, transaction lifecycles and system design considerations

  • Experience designing and evolving distributed systems and microservices architectures

  • You’ve operated at Principal or Staff level, shaping technical direction across multiple teams or domains

  • Strong judgement and the ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural outcomes

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning complex problems into clear, practical technical approaches

  • Clear and thoughtful communicator, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences

  • You have strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and modern infrastructure practices

  • You’ve worked on systems where scale, reliability, performance and cost trade-offs matter, and can navigate those decisions thoughtfully

  • You’ve contributed to engineering standards, architecture patterns or platform direction

  • Interest in or exposure to AI-enabled systems, particularly understanding architectural implications in production

Nice To Have_

  • Experience with transit systems or fare payment systems (e.g. tap-to-ride systems)

    • With the support of the accounting team, oversee the reporting and collection of all guaranteed and back end overrides from suppliers.

    • With the assistance of PR team, manage Canadian PR firm partnership.

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></p>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen">&nbsp;</span></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p>
<hr>
<h3>About the role:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li>
<li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li>
<li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li>
<li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li>
<li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li>
<li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li>
<li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li>
<li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li>
<li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li>
<li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), and Terraform Associate certification are highly desirable.</li>
<li>Bonus points for security certifications from SANS or OffSec.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Our Engineering team</h3>
<p>We’re a group of engineers who are forging new ground together and love partnering with Security on our journey to pull ahead of our competition. You can read about how we think through problems as well as how we learn from mistakes on our blog here:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/we-took-down-production/">How we took down production…</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/beyond-linear-notebooks/">Beyond Linear Notebooks</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/a-pragmatic-approach-to-live-collaboration/">A pragmatic approach to live collaboration</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 class="Heading__HeadingInternal-sc-sir940-0 Heading___StyledHeadingInternal-sc-sir940-1 eQrUa-d">Our stack</h3>
<p>Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $198,750 - $295,000</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</span></a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-cloud-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-cloud-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

This role combines hands-on integration development with end-to-end production ownership, including API design, data mapping, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery.</p><p><strong>General information</strong></p><p>This role focuses on building reliable, maintainable integrations rather than creating new point-to-point integration debt. MuleSoft/API integrations across Salesforce, SAP, and the carrier data lake.</li><li>Define and maintain API contracts, field mappings, transformations, and automated tests.</li><li>Use Data Modeler to develop and maintain accurate data mappings between systems.</li><li>Debug and resolve production integration failures independently, including root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.</li><li>Instrument integration pipelines with appropriate monitoring, logging, and alerting.</li><li>Support Marketing Portfolio transition integrations while avoiding unnecessary point-to-point dependencies and new integration debt.</li><li>Use AI tools to accelerate mapping drafts, API stubs, test generation, documentation, and error-handling boilerplate.</li><li>Review and harden AI-generated output to ensure it meets production standards for reliability, maintainability, and quality.</li><li>Automate replay, retry, alerting, and recovery runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).</li><li>Continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of the integrations you own.</li></ul><p><strong>Required experience</strong></p><ul><li>5+ years of integration engineering experience.</li><li>Hands-on experience with MuleSoft or an equivalent enterprise ESB/API integration platform.</li><li>Experience integrating with SAP, including IDoc, API, and/or BAPI patterns.</li><li>Experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise API patterns.</li><li>Experience with data lake ingestion and integration patterns.</li><li>Strong understanding of API contracts, data mapping, transformations, testing, and integration architecture.</li><li>Demonstrated experience supporting integrations in production, including monitoring, troubleshooting, alerting, retry/replay, and incident resolution.</li><li>Ability to take ownership of production issues and drive them through diagnosis, recovery, and prevention, rather than simply handing them off to another team.</li><li>Experience using AI copilots or agents to accelerate software engineering workflows.</li><li>Strong engineering judgment and the ability to validate, test, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts before they reach production.</li></ul>
